HEADS UP, MOTORISTS! 🚘

Expect traffic along the northbound lanes of the North Luzon Expressway (NLEx) toward Sto. Tomas, Pampanga, as construction of an interchange gets underway.

A counterflow lane will be implemented on the southbound lanes heading to Manila to accommodate northbound motorists.

Construction is scheduled from 10:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. on the following dates: | 📷: NLEx

January 8–9
January 13–14
January 15–16
January 20–21
January 22–23

Visit https://t.co/AuYsgsogFf for more stories and updates
